description: Contract artifacts the content API copies from this repo. Each file's sha256 is recorded here, and __tests__/manifest.test.ts fails when a file changes without its hash being updated. artifactsVersion is the version last handed over to the API, and each file's handedOff is its hash at that hand-off. A file whose sha256 differs from its handedOff is part of the open draft, draftVersion, which is artifactsVersion + 1 while any file differs and absent otherwise; the test holds both to that. At a hand-off, artifactsVersion becomes draftVersion, every handedOff becomes its file's sha256, and draftVersion is removed. A file first added in the draft has a handedOff of 64 zeros until then. The API reports the version it runs in GET /capabilities, so the console can tell when the server's copy is older. See docs/console-content-api-contract.md.

v1.note: Frozen. Accepts credits, session, composer, relatedRecordings (with Credit.artistGlobeId, origin.artistGlobeId). Adopt first.

v2.note: Frozen for the version 4 draft, and handed off with it at the end of phase E. Adds to v1: releases[], subgenreIds, session.studioId/labelId/placeId/source, credits[].source, relatedRecordings[].source (all optional). songBodySchema.ts is regenerated from src/curriculum/types/songLibrary.ts and says the same until new song fields open level v3. The globe_event body's credits are generated from the same Credit, so at the version 4 hand-off they are v2's.
